hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity with a proprietary curve-based mechanism backed by Euler vaults. All swap execution occurs in beforeSwap, which deposits input tokens to and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults while enforcing a curve invariant, with the full delta returned to the pool manager via beforeSwapReturnsDelta.
